unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
keg_communicative_function: Inquiring about and identifying shopping venues
example_el: Πάω στην κεντρική αγορά για ψώνια.
example_en: I am going to the central market for shopping.
notes_or_mnemonics: Feminine in -ά with plural in -ές. Also means the abstract economy or financial market.

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
keg_communicative_function: Shopping for fresh agricultural produce in Greece
example_el: Κάθε Σάββατο πηγαίνουμε στη λαϊκή.
example_en: Every Saturday we go to the street market.
notes_or_mnemonics: Universally referred to as 'η λαϊκή'. Core cultural setting in KEG listening exams.

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
keg_communicative_function: Navigating grocery retail chains
example_el: Κάνω τα ψώνια της εβδομάδας στο σούπερ μάρκετ.
example_en: I do the week's shopping at the supermarket.
notes_or_mnemonics: Indeclinable neuter loanword.

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
keg_communicative_function: Buying bread, bakery goods, and morning pies
example_el: Αγοράζω φρέσκο ψωμί από τον φούρνο.
example_en: I buy fresh bread from the bakery.
notes_or_mnemonics: Masculine in -ος (plural: οι φούρνοι). Synonym of 'το αρτοποιείο'.

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
keg_communicative_function: Purchasing fresh meat and poultry
example_el: Το κρεοπωλείο είναι δίπλα στον φούρνο.
example_en: The butcher shop is next to the bakery.
notes_or_mnemonics: Compound of κρέας (meat) + πωλώ (to sell). Paroxytone neuter in -είο.

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
keg_communicative_function: Referring to commercial stores in general
example_el: Τα μαγαζιά κλείνουν στις εννέα το βράδυ.
example_en: The shops close at nine in the evening.
notes_or_mnemonics: Oxytone neuter in -ί (plural: τα μαγαζιά). Synonym of 'το κατάστημα'.

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
keg_communicative_function: Purchasing cooking oil and Greek staple products
example_el: Χρειαζόμαστε ένα λίτρο ελαιόλαδο.
example_en: We need one liter of olive oil.
notes_or_mnemonics: Neuter in -ι (plural: τα λάδια). 'Ελαιόλαδο' specifically denotes olive oil.

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
keg_communicative_function: Buying grain staples at the supermarket
example_el: Ένα πακέτο ρύζι για πιλάφι, παρακαλώ.
example_en: A package of rice for pilaf, please.
notes_or_mnemonics: Paroxytone neuter in -ι.

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
keg_communicative_function: Buying pasta on grocery shopping trips
example_el: Αγοράζω δύο πακέτα μακαρόνια.
example_en: I am buying two packets of pasta.
notes_or_mnemonics: Plural noun in Greek (τα μακαρόνια). Spelled with one κ.

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
keg_communicative_function: Shopping at greengrocers or open markets
example_el: Στη λαϊκή έχει πάντα φρέσκα φρούτα.
example_en: At the street market there is always fresh fruit.
notes_or_mnemonics: Neuter plural (singular: το φρούτο).

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
keg_communicative_function: Buying fresh vegetables
example_el: Τρώμε πολλά λαχανικά για υγεία.
example_en: We eat a lot of vegetables for good health.
notes_or_mnemonics: Oxytone neuter plural (singular: το λαχανικό).

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
keg_communicative_function: Specifying produce quantities at the market
example_el: Βάλτε μου δύο κιλά ντομάτες για σαλάτα.
example_en: Give me two kilos of tomatoes for salad.
notes_or_mnemonics: Paroxytone feminine in -α with plural in -ες. Accusative keeps -ν before ντ: 'την ντομάτα'.

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
keg_communicative_function: Buying salad vegetables
example_el: Θέλω μισό κιλό αγγούρια.
example_en: I want half a kilo of cucumbers.
notes_or_mnemonics: Spelled with double γ (γγ pronounced [ŋg]). Neuter in -ι.

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
keg_communicative_function: Buying staple cooking vegetables
example_el: Ένα κιλό ξερά κρεμμύδια, παρακαλώ.
example_en: One kilo of dry onions, please.
notes_or_mnemonics: Spelled with double μ (μμ) and upsilon (υ).

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
keg_communicative_function: Inquiring about fruit prices and buying fruit
example_el: Πόσο έχουν τα κόκκινα μήλα;
example_en: How much are the red apples?
notes_or_mnemonics: Paroxytone neuter in -ο with plural in -α (τα μήλα).

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
keg_communicative_function: Purchasing citrus fruit by weight
example_el: Δύο κιλά πορτοκάλια για χυμό, παρακαλώ.
example_en: Two kilos of oranges for juicing, please.
notes_or_mnemonics: Distinguish: 'πορτοκάλι' (noun fruit) vs 'πορτοκαλί' (indeclinable orange color).

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
keg_communicative_function: Stating weights when buying food in Greece
example_el: Ένα κιλό φέτα και μισό κιλό ελιές.
example_en: One kilo of feta and half a kilo of olives.
notes_or_mnemonics: Oxytone neuter in -ό (plural: τα κιλά). 'Μισό κιλό' = half a kilo.

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
keg_communicative_function: Ordering sliced deli meats and cheese by weight
example_el: Διακόσια γραμμάρια τυρί γκούντα σε φέτες.
example_en: Two hundred grams of gouda cheese in slices.
notes_or_mnemonics: Proparoxytone neuter. In Greek deli counters, portions are ordered in hundreds of grams (διακόσια γραμμάρια).

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
keg_communicative_function: Specifying liquid volumes for milk, oil, or wine
example_el: Ένα λίτρο φρέσκο γάλα.
example_en: One liter of fresh milk.
notes_or_mnemonics: Paroxytone neuter in -ο.

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
keg_communicative_function: Ordering bottled drinks and liquids
example_el: Δύο μπουκάλια εμφιαλωμένο νερό.
example_en: Two bottles of bottled water.
notes_or_mnemonics: Paroxytone neuter in -ι.

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
keg_communicative_function: Buying boxed or packaged goods (pasta, coffee, cookies)
example_el: Ένα πακέτο μπισκότα για τα παιδιά.
example_en: A packet of biscuits for the children.
notes_or_mnemonics: Also used in food take-out: 'σε πακέτο' / 'για πακέτο' (to go / take away).

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
keg_communicative_function: Asking for individual portions or pieces
example_el: Ένα κομμάτι τυρόπιτα, παρακαλώ.
example_en: A piece of cheese pie, please.
notes_or_mnemonics: Spelled with double μ (μμ). Plural: τα κομμάτια.

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
keg_communicative_function: Shopping for apparel and garments
example_el: Ψωνίζουμε ρούχα στις εκπτώσεις.
example_en: We shop for clothes during the sales.
notes_or_mnemonics: Regular neuter in -ο. Almost always used in plural 'τα ρούχα' (clothes).

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
keg_communicative_function: Buying trousers or jeans
example_el: Δοκιμάζω ένα μαύρο παντελόνι.
example_en: I am trying on a pair of black trousers.
notes_or_mnemonics: Grammatically singular in Greek (το παντελόνι) unlike English plural 'pants/trousers'.

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
keg_communicative_function: Buying tops and casual shirts
example_el: Μου αρέσει αυτή η μπλε μπλούζα.
example_en: I like this blue top.
notes_or_mnemonics: Paroxytone feminine in -α with plural in -ες.

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
keg_communicative_function: Shopping for formal or business attire
example_el: Ψάχνω ένα άσπρο πουκάμισο για τη δουλειά.
example_en: I am looking for a white shirt for work.
notes_or_mnemonics: Proparoxytone neuter in -ο (plural: τα πουκάμισα).

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
keg_communicative_function: Buying footwear in shoe stores
example_el: Αυτά τα παπούτσια είναι πολύ άνετα.
example_en: These shoes are very comfortable.
notes_or_mnemonics: Neuter plural (singular: το παπούτσι).

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
keg_communicative_function: Asking for clothes size or shoe size
example_el: Τι μέγεθος φοράτε; — Φοράω medium.
example_en: What size do you wear? — I wear medium.
notes_or_mnemonics: Ancient declension neuter in -ος with plural in -η (τα μεγέθη). Note: shoe size is also called 'το νούμερο'.

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
keg_communicative_function: Asking for products in specific colors
example_el: Έχετε αυτό το φόρεμα σε άλλο χρώμα;
example_en: Do you have this dress in another color?
notes_or_mnemonics: Neuter in -μα with plural in -ματα (τα χρώματα).

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
keg_communicative_function: Reading price tags or asking about costs
example_el: Η τιμή είναι πολύ καλή για τέτοια ποιότητα.
example_en: The price is very good for such quality.
notes_or_mnemonics: Oxytone feminine in -ή. In receipts: 'Τιμή μονάδας' = unit price.

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
keg_communicative_function: Handling cash change during transactions
example_el: Ορίστε τα ρέστα σας: πέντε ευρώ.
example_en: Here is your change: five euros.
notes_or_mnemonics: Plural only in commerce: τα ρέστα.

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
keg_communicative_function: Requesting or checking shopping receipts
example_el: Μου δίνετε την απόδειξη, παρακαλώ;
example_en: Could you give me the receipt, please?
notes_or_mnemonics: Feminine noun in -ση with plural in -σεις. Essential keyword in KEG reading tasks matching receipts to shopping lists.

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
keg_communicative_function: Specifying cash payment method at checkout
example_el: Πληρώνετε με μετρητά ή με κάρτα;
example_en: Are you paying with cash or with card?
notes_or_mnemonics: From μετρώ (to count). Always plural: 'πληρώνω με μετρητά'.

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
keg_communicative_function: Paying by debit or credit card
example_el: Μπορώ να πληρώσω με κάρτα;
example_en: Can I pay by card?
notes_or_mnemonics: Universal payment method formula: 'με κάρτα'.

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
back_primary: to buy / to purchase / I buy
keg_communicative_function: Talking about purchasing goods and everyday items
example_el: Αγοράζω φρούτα από τη λαϊκή αγορά.
example_en: I buy fruit from the street market.
notes_or_mnemonics: Regular Type A active verb (-ω, -εις, -ει, -ουμε, -ετε, -ουν). Derived from 'η αγορά'.

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
keg_communicative_function: Inquiring about prices and costs of items
example_el: Πόσο κοστίζει αυτό το παντελόνι;
example_en: How much does this pair of trousers cost?
notes_or_mnemonics: Type A verb. Almost always used in 3rd person singular (κοστίζει) or 3rd person plural (κοστίζουν).

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
keg_communicative_function: Executing payment transactions at stores and supermarkets
example_el: Πληρώνω στο ταμείο με κάρτα.
example_en: I pay at the cash desk by card.
notes_or_mnemonics: Type A active verb: πληρώνω, πληρώνεις, πληρώνει, πληρώνουμε, πληρώνετε, πληρώνουν.

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
back_primary: to look for / to search for / I look for
keg_communicative_function: Asking shop staff for assistance when locating items
example_el: Καλημέρα σας, ψάχνω ένα ζεστό μπουφάν.
example_en: Good morning, I am looking for a warm jacket.
notes_or_mnemonics: Type A active verb. Directly takes direct object in accusative: ψάχνω το ταμείο.

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
back_primary: how much is it? / how much are they?
keg_communicative_function: Asking for prices of singular and plural merchandise
example_el: — Πόσο κάνουν αυτά τα πορτοκάλια; — Ένα ευρώ το κιλό.
example_en: — How much are these oranges? — One euro a kilo.
notes_or_mnemonics: Singular agreement: 'Πόσο κάνει το τυρί;' / Plural agreement: 'Πόσο έχουν / κάνουν τα μήλα;'.

unit_theme: Στην Αγορά, Ψώνια & Τιμές (Shopping, Supermarket & Prices)
keg_communicative_function: Evaluating merchandise prices and comparing store costs
example_el: Αυτό το παλτό είναι πολύ ακριβό.
example_en: This coat is very expensive.
notes_or_mnemonics: Oxytone regular adjective. Direct antonym of 'φθηνός / φτηνός' (cheap / inexpensive).
